checks.name: Fresh balloon is immediately ready with zero local records and bounded visual state
A release before holding does not create a score or completed play
Holding grows continuous pressure and risk without an arbitrary early burst
A second hold cannot reset the timer while the same balloon is inflating
Closer legal releases produce strictly better bounded scores
A stopped balloon awards its result exactly once despite repeated updates and releases
Holding beyond its visible limit pops in under nine seconds and scores zero once
A new press retries directly from success or burst without a separate setup action
Cancellation aborts the live balloon while preserving every earned result
A high-quality release increases streaks; a burst resets the current streak only
Pressure and legal scores are stable at 30 and 120 frames per second
Invalid or huge time steps cannot create NaN, infinite scores or repeated rewards
Risk warning events follow the same pressure progression and do not repeat each frame
Restoring earned progress returns safely to ready even if interrupted during a hold
Hostile or inconsistent saves fall back to a finite playable fresh game
Many real rounds keep capacities short, visual risk comparable and records bounded
